title: A 12-Year Old From Scotland Created A Life-Saving Solar Invention - BGR
summary: Each year, the competition selects one student's idea and Young's solar-powered blanket backpack was the winner in 2024. Thales UK and the RBVE are working in tandem to create and release more of the heated solar-powered blankets created by the young inventor.
